messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Iteratively create reactiveFileReader objects
parts:
I have a bunch of csvs in a data folder that get updated periodically.

I'd like to watch them with the very handy reactiveFileReader().

I'd also like to be able to systematically create a bunch of reactiveFileReader objects via, say, lapply(), loosely following the pattern of this fine example.

But mine doesn't work.

Here's my MRE- relevant code in the midst of the server block.  Thanks in advance, anyone, for help:
library(shiny)
library(readr)

# create 3 dummy files to watch
write_csv(as_data_frame(Sys.time()), "data/file1.csv")
write_csv(as_data_frame(Sys.time()), "data/file2.csv")
write_csv(as_data_frame(Sys.time()), "data/file3.csv")


ui <- fluidPage(
        verbatimTextOutput("file1"),
        verbatimTextOutput("file2"),
        verbatimTextOutput("file3")
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {

   file1 <- reactiveFileReader(intervalMillis = 1000,
                               session = session,
                               filePath = "data/file1.csv",
                               readFunc = read_csv)
   
   files_to_get <- c("file2", "file3")


   #### WHAT I WANT TO DO, CURRENTLY FAILING #####
   other_files <- lapply(files_to_get, function(i) {
     reactiveFileReader(
       intervalMillis = 1000,
       session = session,
       filePath = paste0("data/", i, ".csv"),
       readFunc = read_csv)
     }
   )
  ##########################################
   
   output$file1 <- renderPrint({ file1() })
   output$file2 <- renderPrint({ other_files()[1] }) # DOESN'T WORK
   output$file2 <- renderPrint({ other_files()[2] }) # NADA
}


# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
